newsitem.title: USA: Union Carbide to buy back 10 million additional stocks.
newsitem.headline: Union Carbide to buy back 10 million additional stocks.

text.p: Union Carbide Corp. said Wednesday its board of directors authorised the repurchase of an additional 10 million shares of its stock, giving the company a total authorisation to buy back up to 60 million shares.
So far, it has repurchased 46 million shares since 1993.
Union Carbide said it has been buying back its stock to minimise future earnings dilution from some employee benefits and its dividend reinvestment programme.
The company, which has 124 million shares outstanding, said it also wants to take advantage of market conditions.
Union Carbide's stock was up 81 cents at $53.25 on the New York Stock Exchange.
